links.outcome: Readability scores of original vs ChatGPT-revised webpage text
links.effect: Significant improvements in six readability metric scores using specific-instruction prompt with ChatGPT 3.5 (all P ≤ 0.05); no further improvement with ChatGPT 4.0.
links.quote: Significant improvements were achieved from baseline in six readability metric scores using a specific-instruction prompt with ChatGPT 3.5 (all P ≤ 0.05).

links.outcome: Hallucination and omission rates in ChatGPT content analysis versus human-rated benchmark
links.effect: Rates of hallucination, accuracy, and omission varied widely between factors; ChatGPT 3.5 had high omission rates and ChatGPT 4.0 had high hallucination rates.
links.quote: Automation of content analysis is limited by ChatGPT 3.5's high omission rates and ChatGPT 4.0's high hallucination rates.
